posts.title: Ramayana Part 1 review: This massy retelling of the celebrated epic is apt for the big screen
posts.description: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Part 1 is the massy retelling of Valmiki's Ramayan starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash as Lord Ram, Goddess Sita and Ravana.

posts.title: Body review: Unconventional saga dealing with the extreme after-effects of bullying
posts.description: Body, which stars Manoj Sharma and is written and directed by Abhijit Mazumdar, is a Hindi film dealing with the severe after-effects of bullying.

posts.title: Sohla (Marathi movie) review: Emotional coming-of-age saga of a village kid
posts.description: Sohla is a coming-of-age Marathi movie about a school going kid from a small village in Maharashtra.
